items.name: orb-hydrogen
items.title: Hydrogen
items.description: A quantum-orbital orb: |psi|^2 of a hydrogen-like wave function projected onto a rotating dome, shaded with rainbow chromatic bands over dark metal. Precession and a drifting flow field keep the pattern from ever visibly looping.

items.name: orb-corona
items.title: Corona
items.description: A raymarched SDF shell with volumetric godrays: the space between a sine-warped sphere and a plain one, lit only by light accumulated along each ray as it passes through the hollow.

items.name: orb-nimbus
items.title: Nimbus
items.description: Light diffusing through a cloud: a true volumetric march with Beer-Lambert transmittance, a second march toward the light for self-shadowing, and a Henyey-Greenstein phase function that blooms the lit limb.

items.name: orb-rocaille
items.title: Rocaille
items.description: Ornate scrollwork wrapped onto a sphere: ten colour layers, each folded by a nine-step feedback warp, sampled through a stereographic projection of the orb's dome so the filigree compresses toward the rim.

items.name: orb-quasar
items.title: Quasar
items.description: A Rodrigues-swept core seen through frosted, dispersive glass: an analytic ray/sphere intersection gives an exact normal, jittered for frost and refracted at three indices, so the caustics inside split into rainbow fringes.

items.name: all
items.title: All Orba Orbs
items.description: Installs every orb and the shared WebGL runtime in one command.
